spec.buildGoal: Drag a vector or its axis - or type coordinates - and watch the projection recompute live.
spec.checkGoal: Make the projection zero using a valid, nonzero axis b.

activity.prompt: Make the projection zero using a valid, nonzero axis b.
activity.feedbackPass: Zero - a and b are perpendicular, so a has no component along the axis.
activity.feedbackFail: The projection is not zero yet - move a (or the axis b) until a·b vanishes, then check again.
